sections.title: Summary
sections.text: Frontend engineer with 7 years building design systems and data-heavy interfaces. Led migrations covering 220k lines with zero downtime; currently maintaining an OSS charting library used by **3 commercial dashboards**.

items.head: Northwind Labs
bullets: Led the **design system** rewrite across 4 teams, cutting bundle size 38% and halving first paint
Built a **component testing** pipeline that caught 120+ regressions pre-release, reducing hotfixes by 60%
Drove accessibility to WCAG 2.2 AA across 90 screens, closing 340 audit findings in two quarters

items.head: Brightpath
bullets: Shipped a **virtualised table** rendering 50k rows at 60fps, replacing a grid that froze above 2k
Migrated 220k lines from AngularJS to React incrementally with zero downtime

items.head: Open chart kit
items.intro: A dependency-free SVG charting library with 4.2k stars and 60+ contributors.
items.label: Highlights:
bullets: **Performance**: canvas fallback keeps 100k-point series interactive on low-end devices
**DX**: typed API and zero-config SSR support, adopted by 3 commercial dashboards

sections.title: Skills
bullets: **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, some Rust
**Frameworks**: React, Next.js, Vue; testing with Vitest and Playwright
